2. FireTable/comfy-colab-kit (★ 140 · 24 forks · Python · MIT)
Zero-GPU-Idle Wake-on-Demand ComfyUI Gateway & MCP Server
• Wake-on-Demand L4 GPUs: Boots ephemeral Colab GPU VMs only when requested
• Cloudflare Zero-Trust Access: Protected URL gateway with live boot progress
• Glama-Verified MCP Server: Agents trigger ComfyUI workflows without 24/7 GPU waste

3. better-vault/better-vault (★ 121 · 10 forks · TypeScript · MIT)
Open-Source Bring-Your-Own-Model (BYOM) Alternative to NotebookLM
• Multi-Artifact Synthesis: Turns sources into reports, flashcards, quizzes, tables & diagrams
• Citation-Grounded Chat: Every answer links back to uploaded source documents
• Model Agnostic (AI SDK + Vite 8): Use local, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini models
• Prevents vendor lock-in and keeps proprietary enterprise corpora private
4. ken050210/vertex-streaming-anti-truncation (★ 51 · 4 forks · JS · MIT)
Streaming Tool-Argument Anti-Truncation Gateway for Vertex AI & Gemini
• Tool-Call Payload Encapsulation: Writes body into tool args & restores streaming text
• Standalone Docker/Node Gateway: Exposes OpenAI-compatible endpoints for any client
• Clear Block Diagnostics: Surfaces exact upstream Google safety/filter reasons
• Supports service-account & Express API keys with streaming/non-streaming modes
